fonction: Dense bone built of osteons (haversian systems): a central canal with blood vessels ringed by lamellae of matrix
Small spaces that hold osteocytes, linked by tiny channels that carry nutrients
Trabeculae (plates and bars) that follow lines of stress; the spaces between them hold red marrow
Mature bone cells within the matrix
Resorb (break down) bone; their balance with osteoblasts maintains bone tissue
{v:A_OS_AXIAL} bones: skull (with the ear ossicles), hyoid, vertebral column, thoracic cage (sternum and ribs)
{v:A_OS_APPEND} bones: pectoral girdle (clavicles, scapulae), upper limbs, pelvic girdle (hip bones), lower limbs
Immovable joints, bones held by thin fibrous tissue (e.g., skull sutures)
Slightly movable joints joined by cartilage (e.g., pubic symphysis, intervertebral disks, costal cartilages)
Freely movable, the most common adult joints: articular cartilage, joint cavity, fibrous capsule with ligaments, synovial membrane making lubricating fluid
